decision_reason: Dispatch-sandbox probe is a CLI-determinism contract; proptest's repeated-sample property test on bd version+which bd is the only legal binding; kani/verus/flux-rs have no production Rust to model.

SchemaErrorClass::parse is a closed-grammar hostile-input parser over bd stderr strings; cargo-fuzz carries the -max_total_time=120 corpus; differential round-trip oracle rejects every invalid input class.

BeadsConfig and BeadsMetadata round-trip is a cargo-deny-style structural regression gate; cargo-fuzz carries the precedence-corruption corpus; differential fuzz oracle rejects any cross-mixing of forbidden keys across the precedence layers.

AddSchemaMigration::statement is a closed-grammar hostile-input parser; cargo-fuzz carries the -max_total_time=120 corpus; round-trip oracle rejects every plain-column revival of depends_on_id outside a STORED/COMMENTED context.

Post-repair verification re-execution is a property-pressure test against the live shared Dolt server; proptest carries the deterministic-seed model_bounds and pairs a should_fail assertion for the bad-config corpus so a false-green cannot survive the run.

Bead vb-t0iw9 is metadata/config/dispatch-sandbox repair only. codebase-map.md §71 enumerates excluded paths and confirms touched_crates is empty; delivery-scope.jsonl:touched_crates is the empty list; no crates/** exists for this bead so there is no Verus exec fn surface to bind against.

Bead vb-t0iw9 is metadata/config/dispatch-sandbox repair only. Kani requires a #[kani::proof] harness over a Rust exec fn; codebase-map.md §71 confirms no production Rust is in scope for this bead so the kani harness target does not exist.

Bead vb-t0iw9 is metadata/config/dispatch-sandbox repair only. Flux requires a refined Rust source with #![flux::cfg]; codebase-map.md §71 and delivery-scope.jsonl:touched_crates confirm no production Rust exists for this bead, so a Flux refinement target is impossible.

Loom models concurrency interleavings in cfg(loom)-aware Rust sync modules. The dispatch-sandbox probe and the surrounding workflow-model.md lifecycle states (workflow-model.md lines 5-17) are single-threaded CLI invocations; domain-model.md §56-60 enumerates open decisions and lists no concurrency concerns.

Miri requires `unsafe` Rust constructs to detect UB. AGENTS.md Engineering Rules forbid `unsafe`; codebase-map.md §71 confirms no production Rust exists for this bead; the bead touches only .beads/config.yaml, .beads/metadata.json, and .beads/vb-t0iw9/*.md evidence files, so Miri's UB-modeling surface is absent.

OB-001 (dispatch-sandbox capture) is a CLI behavior contract; cargo-fuzz is the appropriate lane for parse_canonicalization in the seed corpus, and PO-T0IW9-002 already exercises the same closed-grammar parser as cargo-fuzz. Adding a second cargo-fuzz obligation over OB-001 would duplicate coverage without extending the evidence base, so this lane decision records the deferral with full evidence refs.

Verus requires a Rust exec fn over closed ConfigKey/MetadataKey enums to model the illegal_state risk; the closed enum is defined in type-contracts.md but lives outside crates/** and the proof-side mirror model is an evidence Markdown file, not a Rust source. Therefore Verus production-binding is structurally impossible for this bead.
